resolution.summary: All project Python commands use a CMD entrypoint backed by a validating PowerShell implementation, or an exact workspace-provided interpreter path; the launcher works with an empty PATH, forwards Python options such as -m, and rejects an invalid explicit runtime without fallback.

symptom.summary: A project command invoked the bare name python, and Windows PowerShell returned CommandNotFoundException even though the bundled workspace Python runtime existed.
